title: Safe-CLIP: Removing NSFW Concepts from Vision-and-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the probability of generating or retrieving sexually explicit, violent, and unsafe images or text using automated classifiers like NudeNet, Q16, and DistilBERT across cross-modal retrieval and generation tasks.

Measuring the generation of hateful, harassing, discriminatory, and toxic content by evaluating model outputs against specific prompt categories from the I2P and ViSU datasets, and scoring text toxicity using the Perspective API.
